about: ACE-Step 1.5 cue spec, round 2. Every level has an original motif (tools/music_motifs.py). tools/music_guide.py renders each cue's motif arrangement to a guide; ACE-Step re-performs the guide audio-to-audio (acestep15-a2a.json: VAEEncodeAudio + partial denoise) with the level's genre take as ReferenceTimbreAudio, so all tiers, the intro and the outro of a level share riff, harmony, bar grid and instrument sound. Reference takes are text-to-music (acestep15-cue.json) and are not shipped. The pipeline picks one candidate per cue by motif similarity to its guide and spectral closeness to the reference, cuts the guide-aligned window, builds the loop seam and encodes. All music is original; prompts never name an existing song, band, game or composer.
common_tags: instrumental, no vocals, original video game soundtrack, 120 bpm, 4/4, steady tempo

kinds.loop: whole file loops; length = beats exactly; the first crossfade_s blend the continuation into the start so the wrap is continuous
kinds.tail: plays `beats` once, then the appended copy of its last bar loops (loopStart..loopEnd) until the next cue
kinds.oneshot: plays `beats` once and ends with a fade over `fade_s`
kinds.sprite: accent sprite: one slot of `slot_beats` per accent (dive, laststand, hatch, reinforce), played on demand
kinds.reference: text-to-music genre take used only as the timbre reference of its group; not shipped
